note: One attempt = one --check run on a distinct spec. Every attempt below has its raw --check bytes in attempts-log.jsonl (record wrapper). Final specs are marked final: true.

views.cluster: host-local: local virtual nets + overlay ingress into the host

attempts.note: First draft: all 8 host-side relations in ONE view (tb). --check extent=66x62, so it cannot fit 47 rows: each rank gap is as tall as the widest label crossing it. Rejected on measured height, not on taste.

Same 8 relations, label_slot:true on all 8 edges to remove the tall rank gaps. --check exited 1: 'no obstacle-safe route for vm -> virbr, virbr -> box, ts -> box, ts -> bond0, box -> wlp, box -> bond0'. Gutters on every edge of a 4-rank converged view leave no corridor. Rejected.
Split the cluster to 3 ranks (e6/e7/e8 moved to v2). --check extent=55x44, crossings 0 bridges 0 touching bends, labels 5/5 placed, 0 ambiguous owners. Chosen.
